leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function to calculate the total hours required to eat all bananas at a given eating speed.
Apply binary search to efficiently find the minimum eating speed within a defined range.
Construct a solution that checks if a given speed allows Koko to finish within the guard's return time.
Initialize and manipulate variables to track the low and high bounds for the binary search.
Configure the loop condition and update logic to converge on the optimal eating speed.
Integrate the helper calculation within the main search function to produce the final result.
Control the flow to return the minimum integer eating speed that satisfies the time constraint.
